title: Data Platform Engineer Roadmap
subtitle: A structured learning path from data engineering fundamentals to designing, building, securing, automating and managing scalable modern data platforms.

roadmap.title: SQL Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Build a strong SQL foundation for working with modern data platforms.

roadmap.title: Python for Data Engineering
roadmap.description: Learn Python for automation, data processing and platform engineering workflows.

roadmap.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Understand the core concepts behind modern data engineering platforms.

roadmap.title: Cloud Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Understand the cloud concepts required to build scalable data platforms.

roadmap.title: Data Platform Architecture
roadmap.description: Learn how modern enterprise data platforms are designed and organized.

roadmap.title: Data Lakes & Data Warehouses
roadmap.description: Learn how to design and operate reliable data storage and analytics platforms.

roadmap.title: Data Ingestion
roadmap.description: Build reliable ingestion systems for batch and streaming data sources.

roadmap.title: ETL & ELT Pipelines
roadmap.description: Design scalable transformation pipelines for enterprise data platforms.

roadmap.title: Data Orchestration
roadmap.description: Automate and manage complex data workflows using orchestration tools.

roadmap.title: Apache Spark & Distributed Processing
roadmap.description: Learn distributed data processing for large-scale data platform workloads.

roadmap.title: Streaming Data Platforms
roadmap.description: Build real-time and event-driven data platform components.

roadmap.title: Data Governance & Security
roadmap.description: Implement governance, access control and security across enterprise data platforms.

roadmap.title: Data Quality & Observability
roadmap.description: Monitor data reliability, freshness and pipeline health across the platform.

roadmap.title: Platform DevOps & Infrastructure
roadmap.description: Learn engineering practices for deploying and managing data platform infrastructure.

roadmap.title: Performance & Cost Optimization
roadmap.description: Optimize data platforms for performance, reliability and cloud cost efficiency.

roadmap.title: Production Data Platform
roadmap.description: Combine the complete skill set to design and operate a production-ready data platform.

roadmap.title: Real-World Data Platform Projects
roadmap.description: Build practical projects that demonstrate production-level data platform engineering skills.

roadmap.title: Interview & Career Preparation
roadmap.description: Prepare for Data Platform Engineer interviews and real-world engineering responsibilities.
